top_signals.title: Pakistan Targets Growth of More Than 4% for 2026
top_signals.summary: Pakistani Finance Minister Muhammad Aurangzeb discusses the country's financing needs and economic growth outlook. He speaks with Avril Hong on the sidelines of the IMF and World Bank Annual Meetings in Bangkok. (Corrects event’s location in video description.) (Source: Bloomberg)
